title: Startup loading + fail-safe router guards to eliminate black screen

requirements.summary: Guarantee a visible full-screen startup loading UI from the root while Internet Identity and initial profile resolution are pending, regardless of initial route.
acceptanceCriteria: When the app first loads (hard refresh) and auth/profile state is still resolving, the user sees a full-screen loading UI (not a black/blank screen).
This loading UI is shown regardless of which route is initially loaded (e.g., '/', '/login', '/exercises').
The loading UI uses clear English user-facing text.

file_operations.description: Add a root-level startup gate in RootComponent that renders the AppLoadingScreen (full-screen) until Internet Identity initialization is complete and (when authenticated) the initial user profile query is resolved; ensure this gate wraps Outlet so it applies to all initial routes. Use the authorization component guidance for auth/profile state sequencing and cache clearing patterns; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update the loading screen copy to be explicit English text about starting the app and loading authentication/profile (avoid vague/blank feel); keep it full-screen and theme-consistent. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Extend the shared auth store to track deterministic startup resolution state needed by the root gate (e.g., resolved vs pending, and last-known phase), without changing immutable auth hooks. Ensure the store can represent 'authenticated but profile still resolving' distinctly from 'unauthenticated guest'. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Make TanStack Router auth/onboarding guards fail-safe: on auth/profile resolution error/timeout, render a themed router fallback instead of proceeding into routes that may render nothing.
acceptanceCriteria: If auth/profile resolution fails (e.g., timeout), the UI displays an error/fallback screen consistent with the dark EVRVEST theme (not a black/blank screen).
The fallback screen includes an English explanation and a way to recover (e.g., reload).
Route guards do not swallow failures in a way that allows the app to proceed into an indeterminate state with no visible UI.

file_operations.description: Update beforeLoad guards (login/onboarding/layout) to stop swallowing waitUntilResolved failures: if auth/profile resolution rejects (timeout/error), rethrow an Error that will be handled by the router errorComponent/defaultErrorComponent (rather than continuing into the route). Keep redirects via beforeLoad/redirect only (no imperative navigation during render). Use the authorization component guidance for handling auth failures gracefully; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure fallback UI messaging is clear English and dark-theme consistent for startup/auth resolution failures (e.g., suggest reload/reset). Keep a visible recovery control and avoid exposing sensitive details. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add structured error/timeout context capture for router-guard waiting (e.g., store last phase and timestamp) so guards can throw meaningful, non-sensitive errors and the fallback UI can display an actionable message. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Provide a deterministic, user-visible startup recovery action that resets startup session state and retries startup without ever showing a blank screen.
acceptanceCriteria: When startup resolution fails, the fallback UI provides a clearly labeled recovery action in English (e.g., “Reload Application”).
Invoking the recovery action results in the app attempting startup again and showing loading/fallback UI as appropriate (never blank).

file_operations.description: Enhance the recovery action to perform a deterministic 'startup reset' before reloading (e.g., clear any sessionStorage items used for persisted routing/guard waits and remove any persisted URL/session routing parameters used for navigation), then reload the application. Keep the button label in English (e.g., “Reload Application”). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add/adjust a small utility to clear any persisted URL/session routing parameters used by the app’s navigation flow (sessionStorage + hash/query handling) so RouteErrorFallback can reliably reset startup routing state prior to reload. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the enhanced fallback recovery behavior into router error handling by ensuring thrown startup/auth resolution errors reach RouteErrorFallback and do not transition into indeterminate routes. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add production-safe diagnostics for startup/auth resolution phases to identify where black-screen conditions originate, without exposing sensitive data.
acceptanceCriteria: On startup issues, console logs clearly indicate which phase is blocked or failed (identity init, profile load, router guard wait).
Diagnostics do not expose sensitive user data.

file_operations.description: Add lightweight console.warn diagnostics (guarded to be production-safe) that log phase transitions and timeouts for waitUntilResolved (e.g., 'identity init pending', 'profile load pending', 'router guard timeout'), without logging principals, tokens, or profile contents. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add startup-phase console warnings in RootComponent for identity initialization and profile query resolution progression (identity init vs profile load vs 'router guard waiting'), ensuring no sensitive data is logged. Use the authorization component guidance for safe auth diagnostics and cache clearing expectations; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
